Definition: Integration of CRVS data (births, deaths, marriages) into data exchange for real-time verification and service eligibility
Comments: Unified Digital Civil Registration Service piloted in 19 districts (August 2025). Records stored in a centralized national database. Testing interfaces to integrate with health, education, national ID, and immigration services. Only 3% of children under five currently have registered births. Ministry of Education committed to piloting CRVS integration in school enrolment. Under development with partial integration.

Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: National digital ID system Tirsi Aqoonsi launched September 2023 by NIRA. Over 1 million enrolled by late 2025; target 15 million by 2029. Hubiye platform for ID verification. Mass registration campaign launched August 2025 in Mogadishu. Telecom and banking sectors connecting to national ID. However, full integration with government services remains nascent. World Bank SCALED-UP project supports NIRA.

Comments: GovStack (2024) implementing digital high school records (HSR) use case with Ministry of Education - digitizing certificates and enabling online access. Definition: Integration of health records, patient registration, immunization data, and health insurance into data exchange
Comments: CRVS system testing interfaces with health services (2025). Baxnaano social protection program integrating health and nutrition conditional cash transfers. Ministry of Health and MoLSA coordinating on health-linked social protection. However, health systems are fragmented with parallel NGO/UN delivery structures. No unified health data exchange platform. Planned integration with CRVS under development.

Definition: Integration with national payment systems for government-to-person (G2P), government-to-business (G2B) transactions via data exchange
Comments: Somalia has highly developed mobile money ecosystem (over 80% adults use mobile money). Somali Instant Payment System (SIPS) for real-time account-to-account payments. Somalia Payment Switch (SPS) connecting banks, cards, ATMs, POS. EVC-Plus (Hormuud) achieved interoperability with banks in 2024. Universal QR code standard launched. CBS National Payment System (NPS) established 2021. Real-Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) system operational. Social protection cash transfers via mobile wallets. Partially integrated with government services.

Definition: Integration of social assistance programs, grant registries, beneficiary management systems
Comments: Baxnaano social assistance program uses Unified Social Registry (USR) and digital payment via mobile wallets. USR collects socioeconomic data for dynamic data sharing. National Socio-Economic Survey to collect USR data from 1.88 million households planned for 2024. World Bank Building Opportunities project (P507443, 2025) supports USR Dynamic Update Mechanism and adaptive social protection delivery. Partially integrated.

Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: Data Protection Law enacted 2023, establishing the Data Protection Authority (DPA) as national trust layer. Identification and Registration Act (Law No. 009 of 2023) enacted. National Communications Act (October 2017) provides telecoms regulation. Draft bills on Electronic Transactions, Cybersecurity, and Cybercrime are before Parliament. GovStack notes 'no enabling legislation for data sharing and data analysis yet' but the Data Protection Law provides foundational framework.

Definition: Whether a detailed implementation roadmap with phases, milestones, and timelines exists for data exchange development
Comments: GovStack/EstDev developed a national Digital Government Roadmap as a guiding document for digital transformation. Definition: Whether a formal strategy or policy document exists specifically for government data exchange and interoperability
Comments: National ICT Policy and Strategy 2019-2024 included e-Government as a focus area. Digital Transformation Strategy 2025-2030 being finalized (national consultation October 2025, ITU support). Strategy will coordinate all national digital initiatives. Interoperability covered within broader strategy, not in a standalone data exchange strategy. MoCT also developing a Data Governance Policy and Government Enterprise Architecture.

Comments: No operational whole-of-government data exchange platform. GovStack assessment (2024) confirms 'a holistic Government Enterprise Architecture and interoperability platform has not yet been developed â€“ currently, all agencies have their own systems and guidelines.' Definition: Extent to which the data exchange enables services accessible to all population groups including persons with disabilities, elderly, low literacy
Comments: Internet penetration ~55% (2025 DataReportal, likely urban-skewed) but connectivity is fragile. Low literacy rates. $6-7 ID card fees excluded many citizens. Mobile money is widely accessible (80% adults use it). NIRA mobile registration teams deployed. However, fragile state context, limited electricity access in rural areas, and lack of formal accessibility provisions limit inclusivity of data exchange systems.

Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: Data Protection Law 2023 allows cross-border data transfers based on adequacy, contractual safeguards, or consent. DPA established. National Data Center planned (operational early 2026) to consolidate critical applications. Horn of Africa Initiative notes 'framework remains at an early stage, with further regulatory guidance and institutional capacity needed.' Limited but developing controls.

Definition: Extent to which provincial/state and local governments participate in the data exchange
Comments: Somalia has Federal Member States (Jubbaland, Southwest, Hirshabelle, Galmudug, Northeastern State). CRVS digital pilot involves local administrations in all Federal Member States (19 districts). OPM and MoCT working to coordinate DPI across federal and state levels. Sub-national participation is emerging and planned.

Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Whether data exchange infrastructure and services reach rural and remote areas or concentrate in urban centers
Comments: Significant urban-rural divide. 4G/LTE coverage concentrated in Mogadishu and Hargeisa. 73% of broadband market 'not serviceable' due to absent backbone fiber (World Bank). Rural areas face security risks, limited power, and no fixed broadband. Digital services primarily urban-centric. NIRA mobile registration teams attempt rural outreach.
